themeHint: “System” follows your device’s light or dark mode.
languageHint: Language of buttons and hints. The language you study is set separately.
retentionHint: Higher means more frequent reviews and less forgetting. Now {percent}%.
limitsHint: No limits by default: the deck can be reviewed until it is empty.
typing: Type the word instead of flipping
autoSpeak: Speak the word automatically when the card turns over
gamificationHint: Rewards, the character and celebrations. Applies right away.

gamificationModes.maxHint: Animations, confetti and a lively character. Bright and fun — great for children.
gamificationModes.mediumHint: Rewards, achievements and the character stay, without animations that make you wait.
gamificationModes.offHint: Just learning: no character and no celebrations.

gradeButtonsOnPhone: Grade buttons under the card on phones
dictionariesHint: The "Find" button next to a word looks up translations and examples in free open sources. Suggestions are only offered — you choose what to keep.

dictionaryRoles.tatoeba: real example sentences in many languages

tourHint: A short tour of the home screen and the pages of the app.
